silhouette.reason: Brute head, tusks, topknot and spiked pauldrons read at a glance in every view.
fixes: a clearer neck line under the jaw in the SIDE view

proportions.reason: Head, tusks and ears read against the jaw; the pauldrons sit outboard of the shoulders with a visible gap in FRONT, so the armour looks hung beside the body rather than worn.
fixes: move the pauldrons in 3–4 cm so they rest on the deltoid
drop the topknot tail arc 1 cm

materials.reason: Painted steel with rivets and rust, leather baldric, fur collar and bone spikes separate; skin is one roughness; the baldric reads cream in sheet.png but brown leather in hero.png.
fixes: roughness variation on the skin (oily forehead, matte cheeks)
one leather colour for the baldric across both renderers

detail.reason: Scars, war paint, rivets, buckle, fur clumps, wound bun and lamed pauldrons.
fixes: finer hair strands on the tail locks

wear.reason: Dents, chipped paint and rust on the pauldrons, scars on the face.
fixes: dirt on the fur and strap

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps mass and armour but the pauldrons turn into flat hollow slabs and the skin breaks into blotchy faceted patches.
fixes: keep the pauldron dome as a closed 8-segment shell at LOD2
average the skin vertex colour per LOD2 face instead of sampling one corner

technical.reason: QA clean; 180k / 46k / 4.8k tris is far over a game bust budget; pauldron lames and fur clumps eat most of it.
fixes: halve pauldron lame and fur clump segment counts at LOD0
orbit bore + socket joints like the other busts
